newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices continue weak.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices continue weak.

text.p: Millfeed prices continued to be steady to lower in most markets Wednesday, as dealers reported light demand because of greening pastures and competition from lower-priced supplies in nearby markets.

Buffalo dealers kept offers unchanged there, but said they may decrease soon because of lower-priced millfeeds being offered in eastern Ohio. Also, they said offers were thin for June delivery and should drop as demand seasonally wanes for that position.
"It will be difficult to sell June, unless values get real cheap," a Buffalo dealer said.
